parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must conduct inquiries into data fiduciaries' compliance with the DPDP Act following the principles of natural justice.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the Board conducts inquiries into data fiduciaries' compliance with the DPDP Act following the principles of natural justice.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to inquire into compliance with the Act.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must provide reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the Board provides reasons for its actions during the course of an inquiry.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to record reasons for actions during an inquiry.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must have the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for matters relating to data compliance.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the Board has the same powers as a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, for data compliance matters.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to have the same powers as a civil court for data compliance.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board must inspect data, books, documents, and other records of data fiduciaries as part of its functions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the Board inspects data, books, documents, and other records of data fiduciaries as part of its functions.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to inspect data and records of data fiduciaries.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Board may issue interim orders during an inquiry, after giving the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the Board issues interim orders during an inquiry after providing the person concerned an opportunity of being heard.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to data fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is derived from the obligation to issue interim orders after providing an opportunity of being heard.
